mechanism: Calcium supplements reduce gastrointestinal absorption of zoledronic acid when administered orally, though zoledronic acid is typically given intravenously, making this interaction clinically relevant mainly for oral bisphosphonates or when calcium is given shortly after IV zoledronic acid.
action: Separate calcium supplementation by at least 30 minutes before or 2 hours after zoledronic acid administration; monitor serum calcium levels as zoledronic acid may cause hypocalcemia.
